d.d: A person whose outlook is scornfully negative.
A person who believes that all people are motivated by selfishness.
A member of a sect of Ancient Greek philosophers who believed virtue to be the only good and self-control to be the only means of achieving virtue.

d.x: the cynic, or Sothic, year; cynic cycle

d.d: Of or relating to the Cynics.
Of or relating to the belief that human actions are motivated only or primarily by base desires or selfishness.
Skeptical of the integrity, sincerity, or motives of others.
Bitterly or jadedly distrustful or contemptuous; mocking.
An emotion of jaded negativity, or a general distrust of the integrity or professed motives of others, due to belief that people are motivated solely by disguised self-interest.
A scornfully pessimistic comment or act.
